originality.rationale: The first-moment theory of LD is established and not claimed as new. Full-text inspections of arxiv:0712.4288, 1404.6360, and 1403.4763 find no sharp dual mean–variance tradeoff boundary; research-index semantic queries and accessible previously established claims were compared by implication. The closest previously examined invasion-model analogue uses a different transition mechanism. Remaining risk is undiscovered literature under absorption-time variability or edge sensitivity.
residual_risks: A published paper or database may have exact small-network first and second absorption-time moments under different terminology not captured by indexed searches.
